simplifications.simplification_text: In a qualifying club, shops don't technically sell alcohol because the member owns part of the alcohol stock and the money they pay is just to preserve equity between members because one may drink more than another. The only exception is when alcohol is sold to guests.

source_text: Building on improvements to the Lower Don and Sheffield and Tinsley Canal, emerging SDF policies will require developments alongside rivers and the Canal to make more of their potential for wildlife and open space, public access and celebration of any heritage aspects.

simplifications.simplification_text: Emerging SDF policies aim to build on improvements to the Lower Don and Sheffield and Tinsley Canal.  This will require developments close to rivers and the canal that should make them better for wildlife, create open spaces, improve public access and celebrate any heritage aspects of the area under development.

source_text: The NDF recommends a number of priority projects to deliver new housing and public realm improvements so that the area changes to become characterised as a safe, high quality and affordable area to live with housing choice, good facilities and a good location in the city.

simplifications.simplification_text: The NDF recommends improvements to housing and public space in the area. These improvements should help the area to be seen as safe, with good and affordable housing.
